data.description:
## Story DD Coverage
Supports dd-4 (unit tests written and passing). Data leaf for dd-1 (preflight) and dd-3 (purity test).

## Testing Mode
RED

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Unit tests pass (exit 0)
  Verify: pytest -xvs tests/unit/dso_reconciler/test_config.py
- [ ] Lint passes (exit 0)
  Verify: make lint-ruff
- [ ] Format check passes (exit 0)
  Verify: make format-check
- [ ] local_to_jira_status is a non-empty dict[str, str] exported by config.py
  Verify: python -c "from plugins.dso.scripts.dso_reconciler import config; assert isinstance(config.local_to_jira_status, dict) and all(isinstance(k,str) and isinstance(v,str) for k,v in config.local_to_jira_status.items()) and len(config.local_to_jira_status) > 0"
- [ ] Empty-dict kill-switch case is testable — test verifies that an empty mapping never breaks preflight when no update mutations contain a status field
  Verify: pytest -xvs tests/unit/dso_reconciler/test_config.py::test_empty_mapping_is_valid_kill_switch

## Implementation Notes
Add local_to_jira_status: dict[str, str] = { ... } to config.py. Seed with the canonical DSO local statuses (open, in_progress, closed, deleted, plus any others used in fixtures) → their Jira workflow names (To Do, In Progress, Done, etc.). Grep tests/ and fixtures/ for status values currently emitted by the differ to confirm the key set.

Kill-switch: setting local_to_jira_status = {} disables outbound status mapping by causing preflight (task-3) to raise StatusMappingError on any update mutation with 'status' in fields — operators can roll back the feature without code changes by emptying the dict.

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context (all 3 failure messages)
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user with full failure history
If MAX_AGENTS: 0 at sonnet→opus escalation time: skip opus step, escalate to user immediately
data.title: Add local_to_jira_status mapping to config.py
